title: Project Starter Package Checklist

items.text: Project charter / design brief (goal, budget, timeline, KPIs, areas of responsibility, risks)
Title documents for the land plot / asset (asset - an existing facility: built or in progress)
Urban planning conditions and restrictions
items.meta: Design team · Head of CS · A

items.text: Utility connection specifications (power, water, gas, sewage)
items.meta: Design team · Head of CS · A

items.text: Design documentation: site plan, architectural and structural sections, engineering sections (checked by PTD, stamped 'Issued for Construction')
items.meta: Design team · Head of CS · A

items.text: Design documentation review (expertise) - mandatory for every facility
Construction works permit
Approved cost estimate: unit estimates for each work type + facility estimates + summary calculation
Works Schedule with responsible persons assigned

items.text: Funding schedule synchronized with the Works Schedule
Contractor portfolio: tender, 3 proposals, draft contracts

title: Handover-to-Execution Checklist
intro: Gate: 'Tendering' → 'Execution stage'. Filled in by the Head of Client's Service together with the Project Manager. The starter package (Д1) must be completed before this checklist.

items.text: Starter package checklist (Д1) fully completed and approved by the CEO
Cost estimate approved (unit + facility + summary)
Works Schedule with responsible persons approved
items.meta: Works Schedule, Head of CS signature

items.text: Funding schedule synchronized with the Works Schedule and approved
Contracts with contractors signed (tender: 3 proposals + В7, legal review completed)
Contracts with key suppliers executed or agreed
Order appointing the PM and project team signed
Every team member has signed their position contract and acknowledgment of the Regulation
Job descriptions issued against signature
Site handed over to the unit / contractor under an acceptance certificate
Temporary utilities provided (power, water), site facilities arranged
Order appointing the on-site H&S responsible signed; safety briefings conducted
Fencing, information board, safe walkways - completed
Project set up in Worksection: tasks, responsible persons, deadlines
Project registers created (contracts, payments, changes, risks, remarks)
Facility Telegram chat with the Head of Client's Service created, participants added
Project folder on Drive created per the standard structure (documentation, photos, certificates)

title: Month-End Closing Checklist
intro: Filled in by the Site Manager. Go top to bottom - and the month is closed with no debts. Every checkbox = done and submitted.

items.text: Next month's works plan submitted to PTD
Works Schedule submitted together with the plan
Consolidated material requirement with delivery dates submitted
Weekly plan-vs-actual statuses submitted for every Friday of the month (with explanations if behind schedule)
Weekly photo reports submitted for every week
items.meta: every Friday · Е5 → Head of CS, PM

items.text: Machinery Timesheets submitted to PTD for every week, signed
All delivery notes and certificates for the month submitted to PTD
All Concealed Works Acceptance Certificates for the month's works closed: photos + certificates + protocols
Technical Supervision remarks resolved or have an agreed deadline
All unforeseen works processed through a Change Request

sections.title: BY THE 5TH - REPORTING PACKAGE FOR THE PAST MONTH

items.text: Works Completion Certificate filled in, item names per the cost estimate
Certificate signed by the Site Manager
Certificate signed by Technical Supervision
Б3 package checklist fully completed (all 10 checkboxes)
Package submitted to PTD

title: Photo Documentation Checklist
intro: What and how to photograph. Daily photos - to the Telegram chat with the Head of Client's Service; weekly photo report and photos for the Concealed Works Acceptance Certificate - to the archive on Drive. Detailed procedure - Е5.

items.text: 3-5 photos of key site zones: showing which works are underway and how many people
Problem spots of the day (if any): what's blocking work, what broke, what wasn't delivered
Each work item of the week: overall view of the zone BEFORE and AFTER - showing exactly WHAT was done
Frame reference: the shot shows axes / floor / landmark or a sign indicating the zone
Quantity is legible: partitions, screed, utilities - shot so the completed quantity can be assessed

sections.title: 3. BEFORE CLOSING THE CONCEALED WORKS CERTIFICATE - MANDATORY

items.text: Rebar before concreting: overall view + connection nodes + cover-layer spacers
Embedded parts, sleeves, penetrations - close-up, with reference points
Waterproofing: EVERY layer before the next is applied; abutments and corners - close-up
Utility lines before closing: routes, slopes, pressure test (gauge visible in frame)
Compaction of backfill: layer by layer, with equipment visible in frame
Thermal and vapor insulation, fireproofing, anti-corrosion coating - before being covered by subsequent layers
Date and time: date stamp enabled, or the file's metadata preserved
Sharpness and lighting: the object is visible; use extra lighting in dark zones
Sequence: before → in progress → after (mandatory for concealed works)
Archive on Drive: facility folder → year-month → date or work name
Photos for the Concealed Works Acceptance Certificate - in the corresponding certificate's folder, link entered into the certificate (Г2)

title: PTD Verification Checklist (plan and reporting package)
intro: Internal PTD tool. Filled in for every plan (Block A, by the 28th) and every reporting package (Block Б, by the 10th).

sections.title: BLOCK A. MONTHLY PLAN VERIFICATION (by the 28th)

items.text: Work item names in Б1/Б2 - exactly per the cost estimate, no ad hoc wording
Quantities - within the remaining balances of the Cumulative Works Register (Г5)
Works comply with the design and approved changes (register Г1)
Schedule Б2 is technologically realistic: work sequences are not violated
Material requirement (В1) matches the quantities per the norms Е9
Delivery dates in В1 allow ordering and delivering on time

sections.title: BLOCK B. REPORTING PACKAGE VERIFICATION (by the 10th)

items.text: Certificate arithmetic: quantities, totals, cumulative figures - error-free
Names and units of measurement - per the cost estimate, match the plan
Actual vs. the month's plan: deviations are explained
Cumulative register: nothing is closed twice, balances are not exceeded
Signatures of the Site Manager and Technical Supervision - on every certificate
Concealed Works Acceptance Certificate for every concealed work item: photos + certificates + protocols Г7
Timesheets В5 vs. certificates: equipment 'that worked' is reflected in the month's works
Write-off M-29 vs. norms Е9 within tolerance; overruns - with an explanation
Works Completion Certificate signed by the Site Manager
Works Completion Certificate signed by Technical Supervision
Machinery Timesheets for the month - for every unit, signed
Concealed Works Acceptance Certificates for the month's works
Photo documentation for every Concealed Works Acceptance Certificate
Laboratory test protocols (concrete 3/7/28 and others)
Original material certificates (linked to the Concealed Works Acceptance Certificate)
As-built drawings, including partial completion
Delivery/issue notes for the month (if not submitted weekly)
Links to the month's weekly photo reports
